account_setup.title: Set up a Mammotion account for Homey
account_setup.intro: Mammotion's mobile app signs you out whenever another app (like Homey) logs in with the same account. To keep using your own account normally, set up a separate account just for Homey:
account_setup.step1: Create a new Mammotion account (a different email address) — this is the account Homey will use.
account_setup.step2: Open the Mammotion app on your phone, signed in with your normal account, and share your mower(s) with the new account.
account_setup.step3: Sign in to the Mammotion app with the new account and accept the invitation.
account_setup.step4: Tap Continue below, then log in here with the new account's email and password.
account_setup.note: You only need to do this once. After that, your normal account keeps working in the Mammotion app exactly as before.
